entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or exchanges, press three.
Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide me with your order number?

Thank you. I see the order here for the Pro-Ride cycling shoes, delivered on January 6th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's more about the fit. I took them for one ride after installing my cleats, and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't fit my foot shape.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Since you received the cycling shoes just 8 days ago, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for apparel and shoes. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.

That's good to hear, thank you. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of uninstalling the cleats, packing everything up, and driving to the post office, would you be able to add a small credit or a 15% discount code to my account for a future purchase?

I do understand the inconvenience of making a return. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns, I can assure you the refund will be for the full purchase price. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now, so there will be no cost to you to send them back.
Okay, a prepaid label is helpful. I guess a full refund is fair. I appreciate you clarifying the policy. I'll get them shipped back this week.
Excellent. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a more comfortable pair of shoes in the future. Have a great day.
